Name: Delores Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]Perms for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5510]Delores[/url] were open and no one had updated her yet so I took the liberty of doing so! Credits for all original work go to blaaze6, Obamoose, bagibagriela, and IdiotSpree [/size]

[size=4]Delores is a fitness freak, a vegan, and a self-proclaimed hipster who bikes down from Zuzu City everyday to exercise and get away from her roomates. Get to know her and what drives her need for such extreme health![/size]

[size=4]Delores comes with a full schedule and dialogue. She's romanceable and comes with 6 heart events, as well as 4 different looks: original, redhead, spiky hair, and red spiky hair (spiky hair art from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11010]Delores Alternative Portrait and Sprite[/url], which also had open permission). She also has optional seasonal outfits![/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]

[size=4]Gift guide:[/size]
[size=4][b]Loves[/b]: Aquamarine, Salad, Vegetable Medley, Red Plate, Roots Platter, Kale, Blueberry, Energy Tonic, Muscle Remedy, Green Tea
[b]Likes[/b]: Green Bean, Cauliflower, Bread, Fiddlehead Fern, Red Cabbage, Common Mushroom, Summer Spangle, Dandelion
[b]Neutral[/b]: Bone Flute, Prismatic Shard, Pancakes
[b]Dislikes[/b]: Animal Products, Foods that contain animal products or fish as ingredients, Beer
[b]Hates[/b]: Pale Ale, Coffee, Escargot, Fish Stew, Crab Cakes, Lobster Bisque [/size]

[size=4]Heart Event Guide:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]2 Heart Event[/b]: In Cindersap Forest on a Sunny Day between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]4 Heart Event[/b]: In Town on a Sunny Day between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]6 Heart Event[/b]: In Cindersap Forest on a Sunday in Fall between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm (I'd recommend completing it before marrying her.)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]8 Heart Event[/b]: On the Beach between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm (Need to have seen 4 Heart Event)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]10 Heart Event[/b]: You'll get a letter that prompts it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]14 Heart Event[/b]: Enter your farmhouse between 6:10 am and 5:00 pm[/size][/*]
[/list]
